verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an agent/workflow framework, but the evidence shows no product-level versioning or rollback for workflows or agents. 'Versioned datasets' applies to evaluation data, not automations. Pre-production scoring and inspectable workflows are adjacent review features. Any versioning through the user's own source control would be a user-side workaround, not a Mastra capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
